micro_exercise.debugging_without_observability: Without telemetry, diagnosing slowness requires crude host inspections (top, netstat), speculative hypothesis testing, and invasive redeployments with ad-hoc prints. Isolating the bottleneck takes hours. Observability instruments the system to reveal whether slowness stems from upstream ingress spikes, database locks, cache misses, or downstream provider delays within seconds.

liveness_vs_readiness.liveness_probe: /live asserts process event-loop health. Failure triggers container restart by the orchestrator.
liveness_vs_readiness.readiness_probe: /ready asserts backing dependency connectivity (PostgreSQL, Redis). Failure instructs the ingress router to withdraw traffic without restarting the container, preventing cascading restart loops.
